title: Jennifer’s Body: From Box Office Flop to Cult Favorite

commenti.body:
**TrueFilm: An in-depth discussion of film**

I legitimately love movie chats, everywhere always. But my preference and what I want to talk about is indeed not what all spaces are built for. I think that may be the case here.

And also here are other words to fill the word count. Hooray effort. Huzzah. Why are there so many posts on this sub lately (mods are doing great at removing the low-brow ones, but again why).

This one always struck me as a marketing mishap. I don't think the studio really knew what to do and so they marketed it as Megan Fox playing a sexy demon in a horror-comedy. When it turned out to be more about female friendship, shitty guys doing shitty things to women, and much less comedy than the trailer would suggest got this movie killed at the box office. 

On paper, it seems like such a product of the time with Megan Fox and Diablo Cody, but it holds up really well and I'm glad it found an audience. (It also helps that Karyn Kusama is such a skilled director.)
Speaking of word count you said a whole lot of nothing just now. Perhaps stick to the topic somewhat even if you’re venting.
Agreed! I saw it in theaters and really liked it. It reminded me of other satires on high school and Adam Brody's song was a bop
